purpose: D0 validity fixtures (docs/SPEC.md §14.1): the swap-detection battery must flag every fixture with usable_for_d0=true, using only data in this directory. Numbers under expected_flags were recomputed from the raw files on 2026-08-13 by evals/fixtures.mjs, which keeps them honest on every CI run.

fixtures.what_happened: grok-4-20-non-reasoning lost the blind counterbalanced charm battery to the incumbent 38-2 on byte-identical prompts (measurements.md charm-grok, 2026-08-11)

expected_flags.rule: unit-level overall preference, win only when both presentation orders agree
mean whitespace-token count over all 288 candidate replies, raw text
expected_flags.note: recomputes to 36.6 raw (report said 36.1 on cleaned text) vs band 20.5±3

expected_flags.rule: voice-lane mean raw words: candidate / incumbent on the SAME stimuli (pb-merged incumbent arm) — same counting bias both arms

fixtures.what_happened: luna TIED the judged charm comparison (17-18, p=1.00) and still carries known-bad signatures: spoken register 28.2 vs 20.5 words/turn (37% long), zero media tags in 288 replies vs the incumbent's 11, crisis-beat collapse into a risk-assessment script (measurements.md charm-luna, 2026-08-11). The fixture that proves charm parity alone must never pass a model.
fixtures.recovery_note: Raw arms + verdicts recovered 2026-08-13 from the live scratchpad; before that this directory held only the unrelated A-before baseline files and was honestly marked usable_for_d0:false.

expected_flags.note: recomputes to luna 0/288 vs incumbent 11/288 — instruction != emission, the behavioral-policy axis

expected_flags.note: recomputes to 32.3 vs 25.0 raw = 1.29x; rig-cleaned aggregates (pb-metrics) say 28.2 vs 20.5 — the recorded signature

expected_parity.rule: unit-level overall, win only when both orders agree
expected_parity.note: the tie is NOT a flag — it is why this fixture exists: a battery that only measures charm passes luna. Specificity recomputes 9-25 for luna (its real win, recorded).
